correctness.rationale: The forest identity K=S-B for independent site retention makes the claimed mean np-mp^2 and variance p(1-p)[n-3mp+(m+2H)p^2] exact. Classifying all dependent edge-triples gives the stated third-cumulant expression in n,m,H,J,P4, including three-edge stars and paths. For degree-matched trees the H,J terms cancel, leaving -6 p^4 (1-p)^2 delta P4. Six is minimal because all smaller tree degree classes are unique; at six, the (3,1,1) and (2,2,1) spiders have P4=3,4 and PGF difference -p^4(1-p)^2 z(z-1)^3 (one orientation). The frozen standard-library verifier enumerates the relevant unlabeled tree shapes and retained subsets. Independent exact rational checks at p=1/5,1/2,3/4 corroborated the PGF/third-moment gap. The unbounded-n identity comes from edge-triple enumeration, not samples.
